subject: POC handoff / hands-on working session + load-test scheduling
messages:
From: Lucas Reed <lucas.reed@orbitops.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
Cc: poc-coordinator@orbitops.com, Ava Simmons <ava.simmons@orbitops.com>
Date: 2026-12-02T16:05:00-05:00
Subject: POC kickoff / hands-on session — availability and scope

Hi Stephanie,

Thanks again for the demo last week — OrbitOps is keen to move to a hands-on POC. We'd like to schedule the kickoff + working session where your engineers walk us through prompt examples, routing rules, and run a short load test against a small dataset. Goal is to validate latency under our typical 750–1,000 token prompts and confirm routing/fallback behavior.

Initial constraints: our team is available the week of Dec 7 in the mornings (EST). Suggested session length: 90 minutes (45m walkthrough + 30m hands-on + 15m run-through/load test). Can you confirm availability and whether your team needs VPN/firewall details ahead of time?

Attendees on our side: Lucas (CTO), Ava (Platform Lead), and two SREs.

Thanks,
Lucas

--
Lucas Reed
CTO, OrbitOps
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>
To: Lucas Reed <lucas.reed@orbitops.com>
Cc: dev_patel@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, poc-coordinator@orbitops.com
Date: 2026-12-03T09:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff / hands-on session — availability and scope

Hi Lucas — great to hear OrbitOps is ready to jump in. We can do the 90-minute format you propose. Proposed slots (EST mornings):
• Tue Dec 8, 10:00–11:30 EST
• Wed Dec 9, 9:30–11:00 EST
• Thu Dec 10, 10:00–11:30 EST (backup)

Agenda (draft):
1) Introductions & success criteria (10m)
2) Prompt review & expected outputs (20m)
3) Routing/fallback policy walkthrough (20m)
4) Live hands-on: prompt tuning & KV/prefix caching demo (25m)
5) Short load test (10m)
6) Next steps & action owners (5m)

Attachments: poc-agenda-v1.pdf (agenda), sample-prompt-set.csv (suggested prompts).

Dev and Marissa — can you confirm if Tue Dec 8 at 10:00 EST works for engineering? Also, Lucas — for the load test we'll need a simple ephemeral endpoint and a small sample payload (your SREs can provide). If OrbitOps requires IP allowlisting, Karthik will need the final list 48h beforehand.

Thanks,
Steph

--
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Account Exec, Redwood Inference

Marissa — can you lead the prompt quality checklist and collect 6-8 key prompts from Lucas before the session?

—Dev

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie_nguyen@redwood.ai>

Cc: dev_patel@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-12-09T11:10:00-05:00
Subject: Re: POC kickoff / hands-on session — post-session recap & next steps

Thanks again for the session today — short recap and owners below. I captured the items during the demo; please review and flag anything missing.

Recap (high level):
- We walked through the prompt set (6 core prompts + 2 edge cases). Prompt conditioning recommendations were applied live; Marissa captured the baseline metrics.
- Routing: showed primary model + cheap fallback policy; confirmed canary fallback behavior for token spikes.
- KV/prefix caching: demoed a 3x improvement for repeated prefixes in our sample.
- Load test: 2-minute burst run; median token latency ~180ms, p95 ~430ms on hosted pool with the current quantization profile.

Action items and owners (timeline):
1) OrbitOps to share final prompts + 2 sample payloads (Ava) — due EOD Dec 10.
2) Redwood to run extended load sweep (Dev) — schedule window Dec 13–14, results by Dec 15.
3) Karthik to confirm network/KMS steps for Dedicated option and provide IP allowlist template (Karthik) — due Dec 11.
4) Marissa to produce prompt-quality checklist + suggested evaluation metrics and a short write-up (Marissa) — draft by Dec 12.
5) Stephanie to schedule follow-up deep-dive (90m) focused on tuning and rollout plan — proposed Dec 16 or Dec 17 morning EST.

Attachments: loadtest-plan.md (results section will be appended after Dec 15 run). HubSpot record: ORT-1427. Zoom recording saved to Drive link: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/POC-ORT-2026

Please reply with any edits. If everyone is aligned I'll send calendar invites for the Dec 13 extended run and the Dec 16 follow-up.

Thanks,
Steph
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>

Ack on scheduling Dec 13–14 for the extended load sweep.

—Karthik
